comment: The public-domain glTF sample (core/gltf/samples/two-blocks.gltf, CC0; mitcad#1826) through OCCT, run in that folder. Two root nodes: Stand (holding Base and Post) becomes a component placed by an occurrence that turns glTF's Y up into Z up; Marker, a mesh of the design, is a body of the root. Metres become millimetres.
Mesh bodies of one face, closed: their volumes are the boxes' (100 x 10 x 100 and 20 x 150 x 20 mm), single precision as the file keeps it.
Where the design shows them: the post 40 mm along x, 40 mm toward the viewer (-y) and 10 mm up in the stand; the marker 200 mm along x.
The materials as appearances, by their names, in sRGB.
